plan.title: Fitness Programme Summary
plan.subtitle: Key indicators and trends from the programme's impact.

panels.title: Total Participants
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM baseline

panels.title: Gender Distribution
panels.sql: SELECT Gender, COUNT(*) AS count FROM baseline GROUP BY 1

panels.title: Average Shuttle Run Improvement
panels.sql: SELECT AVG(endline."Shuttle run sec" - baseline."Shuttle run sec") AS avg_improvement FROM baseline JOIN endline ON baseline."Child ID" = endline."Child ID"

panels.title: Average Sit-ups Improvement by Coach
panels.sql: SELECT Coach, AVG(endline.Sit_ups - baseline.Sit_ups) AS avg_situps FROM baseline JOIN endline ON baseline."Child ID" = endline."Child ID" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top 10 Improved Shuttle Run Times
panels.sql: SELECT baseline."Child name", endline."Shuttle run sec" - baseline."Shuttle run sec" AS improvement FROM baseline JOIN endline ON baseline."Child ID" = endline."Child ID" ORDER BY improvement DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: The fitness programme engaged a total of {{p1}} children. The participant base was comprised of {{p2.Female}} female and {{p2.Male}} male children. On average, participants demonstrated an improvement of {{p3}} seconds in their shuttle run time, indicating a positive impact on speed and agility.  Coaches showed varying levels of impact on sit-up performance, with the top 10 coaches contributing to an average improvement of {{p4.avg_situps}} sit-ups per child.  The children with the most significant shuttle run improvements are highlighted in the table, showcasing individual success stories within the programme.
